mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.name, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM blog_article a WHERE a.category_id = c.id AND a.status = 1) AS count, c.create_time, c.update_time FROM blog_category c ORDER BY c.id DESC
SELECT c.id, c.name, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM blog_article a WHERE a.category_id = c.id AND a.status = 1) AS count, c.create_time, c.update_time FROM blog_category c WHERE c.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO blog_category (id, name, count) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{count})
mapper.update: UPDATE blog_category SET name = #{name} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE blog_category SET count = #{count} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE blog_category c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT category_id, COUNT(1) AS published_count FROM blog_article WHERE status = 1 GROUP BY category_id ) a ON a.category_id = c.id SET c.count = IFNULL(a.published_count, 0)
